title: How a P-Trap Maintains a Water Seal
description: A sink P-trap operates on gravity and fluid dynamics to protect indoor air quality while allowing efficient wastewater disposal. As water drains from the sink tailpiece into the lower bend of the trap, incoming water pushes existing water over the trap weir and into the horizontal waste arm. When flow stops, gravity retains a precise volume of standing water in the dip, forming the trap seal. This continuous liquid plug prevents hazardous sewer gases from traveling up the pipe into the living space, making it a critical component of every fixture drain.

How a P-Trap Maintains a Water Seal

A sink P-trap operates on gravity and fluid dynamics to protect indoor air quality while allowing efficient wastewater disposal. As water drains from the sink tailpiece into the lower bend of the trap, incoming water pushes existing water over the trap weir and into the horizontal waste arm. When flow stops, gravity retains a precise volume of standing water in the dip, forming the trap seal. This continuous liquid plug prevents hazardous sewer gases from traveling up the pipe into the living space, making it a critical component of every fixture drain.
